title: Vault executor CLI
responsibility: Registers local Vault setup, removal and read-only status commands for macOS and Linux.

outputs.name: VaultSetupCommand.register
outputs.description: Registers the vault command and its setup, remove, and status subcommands. A failed installer surfaces its exit status to the caller.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Reports an unsupported host platform or failure to launch the local installer.
